### Redemption Accomplished
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/redemption-accomplished
Passage: John 19:28-30
Points:
- Jesus' cry of physical thirst on the cross fulfilled Messianic Scripture.
- Christ laid down His life deliberately and only surrendered His spirit once His mission was fulfilled.
- The declaration "It is finished" signified that our redemption and atonement were fully accomplished.
- Believers can rest securely in grace, knowing nothing can be added to Christ's complete payment for sin.

### The Day that Changed Everything
Author: Debbie McDaniel
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-april-14.html
Passage: John 19:30
Points:
- Jesus' final declaration on the cross signaled that humanity's sin debt was paid in full.
- The torn temple veil demonstrated that direct access to God is now open through Christ.
- The midday darkness, earthquake, and opened graves revealed God's power and Christ's victory over death.
- The events surrounding Jesus' death moved witnesses, including the Roman centurion, to recognize Him as God's Son.
